reviewed_domain: All input biases p in [0,1]; Bernoulli bias 1/(2-p), including both endpoints.
Every p in [0,1], integer a>=0 and b>0; Bernoulli bias b/(b+a*p), including coefficient zero.
Any measurable parameter space, probability measure mu, measurable probability kernel kappa to Bool, and conditionally specified callbacks; target mu.bind kappa.
All p in [0,1] and nonnegative integer coefficient lists with positive total, including zero coefficients.
All p in [0,1] and nonnegative coefficient lists of positive total; success is the normalized weighted average of 1-(1-p)^(i+1).
Every p in [0,1) including zero; bias (1-p)*log(1/(1-p)).
Nonnegative integer weights with positive total and equally sized callback lists; all component biases in [0,1], including zero-weight categories.
All input and selector biases p,mu in [0,1] with mu<1 or p>0; bias mu*p/(1-mu+mu*p).
Every integer base >=2 and any fixed expansion with digits in Fin base, including all-zero and all-maximal expansions.
Every nonnegative integer numerator a and positive integer denominator b; exact Bernoulli exp(-a/b).
All input biases, positive natural trial count and scale, and deterministic evaluators specified only on the attainable finite head grid; target is the exact clamped Bernstein mixture.
Every p in [0,1) including zero, and every positive natural order.
Every p strictly between zero and one, either oracle orientation, and every deterministic sign oracle on the reachable unit-interval rational domain.
The concrete parameter-free Bernoulli coin of inverse golden ratio.
Every signed integer numerator and positive denominator; bias sigmoid(a/b)*(1-sigmoid(a/b)).
Every signed integer numerator and positive integer denominator; bias 1/(1+exp(-a/b)).
Every signed integer z and natural precision including zero; bias 1/(1+exp(z/2^precision)).
Every signed a, positive b, nonnegative x, and positive y; bias (1+exp(a/b-x/y))/(1+exp(a/b)).
Every nonnegative integer numerator and positive denominator; exact tanh(a/b).
Every input bias in [0,1], natural a,b,y positive, and natural x with x*b<=a*y, including x=0.
Every valid reciprocal-affine parameter, input bias, and natural repetition count; a separate zero-count theorem allows arbitrary integer parameters and any callback.
Every input bias in [0,1] and every nonnegative integer shift m, including m=0.
The concrete parameter-free Bernoulli coin of sqrt(2)-1.
The concrete parameter-free Bernoulli coin of 1/sqrt(2).
Positive natural m, ell=1 or ell=-1 with m>=3 in the latter case, and every natural k including zero.
All nonnegative rational offsets with positive denominators and positive total exit mass a/b+p+x/y+q; every input bias endpoint is included.
All natural a,b with b>0 and b<=a, and every input bias in [0,1], including a=b,p=0.
Every input bias p in [0,1], including both endpoints, in the real uniform model.
Every input bias p in [0,1], including both deterministic endpoints, in the real uniform model.
All natural a,b,x,y with b>0, b<=a, and y>0, including x=0; exact 1/(a/b+exp(-x/y)).
Every input bias p in [0,1], nonnegative natural numerator x, and positive natural denominator y.
Every input bias p in [0,1], natural a including zero, and positive natural b; exact tanh((a/b)*p).
Every input bias p in [0,1], every signed integer numerator a, and positive natural denominator b; exact sigmoid((a/b)*p).
Every input bias p in [0,1], every signed integer a, and positive integer b; odds multiplied by exp(a/b).
All nonnegative integer selector weights of positive sum, portkey numerator between zero and its positive denominator, and all input biases with strictly positive weighted accepted mass.
Every input bias p in [0,1] and every finite list of nonnegative rational coefficients with positive denominators, including zero coefficients and the empty list.

All input biases, natural heights, and positive integer a,b; separate base theorem covers every integer height<=1 with arbitrary rational parameters and callback, without a uniform-integer assumption.
All input biases, natural heights, positive integer a,b; separate base theorem covers every integer height<=0 and arbitrary parameters/callback without a uniform-integer assumption.

All positive integer numerators bounded by their denominators, every terminal-flag sequence and natural start, with a deterministic coefficient oracle required only at positions reachable before the first terminal flag.
Every positive simple denominator sequence with arbitrary terminal flags and a deterministic oracle only on reachable indices beginning at one.
All unit-interval biases, integer a>=0,b>0; only the expanding branch requires 0<e<f and (a/b)*p<=1-e/f. Contracting coefficients admit arbitrary integer margins.
Every unit-interval target, deterministic rational enclosures from index zero, and arbitrarily small widths; no monotonicity or convergence rate is assumed.
Every unit-interval input bias including zero and one, with an arbitrary verified callback and arbitrary ENNReal credits.
Every unit-interval input bias and arbitrary verified callback, including both endpoints and arbitrary ENNReal credits.

All unit-interval biases, natural powers and the complete conditional-margin Linear domain. An additional zero-power theorem covers arbitrary integer parameters and unknown callbacks without UniformInt.
All unit-interval component biases with a supplied rational margin 0<e<f and p+q<=1-e/f, including zero components and equality at the margin.
All unit-interval component biases and rational margins 0<e<f with e/f<=p-q, including a zero subtrahend and equality at the margin.
All unit-interval denominator p and numerator q with 0<e<f and e/f<=p-q, including q=0.
All integer a,b,y>0,x>=0; only an expanding final coefficient (x+y)*b>y*a requires 0<e<f and (x/y+p)/(a/b)<=1-e/f. Contracting cases retain arbitrary integer margins.
All natural offsets a,x>=0 and positive denominators b,y; either x*b+b*y<=a*y with arbitrary integer margins, or 0<e<f and e/f bounded by the literal normalized denominator-minus-numerator gap.

All unit-interval p, integers 0<=a<b, positive lower denominator and lower numerator<=denominator; positive a additionally requires certified lower> a/b and p>=lower. Separate zero and unit-lower theorems require no input callback contract; zero also requires no UniformInt and permits negative lower numerators.
All unit-interval input biases including0/1, each actual mode0/1/2 and arbitrary verified input callbacks; arbitrary masks and ENNReal credits.
Every unit-interval input bias, arbitrary verified callback and arbitrary ENNReal output credits, including both endpoints.
Every unit-interval input bias, arbitrary verified callback and arbitrary ENNReal output credits, including both endpoints.
Every unit-interval input bias includingzero/one, arbitrary verified callback and arbitrary ENNReal output credits.
Every unit-interval input bias and all integer shifts a>=0,b>0, including zero shift and both input endpoints, with arbitrary verified callbacks.
Every unit-interval input bias and integer a>=0,b>0, including zero shift and both endpoints.
Every unit-interval input bias and all natural m,k including zero, with arbitrary verified callbacks and ENNReal output credits.

All natural bases>=2, unit-interval probabilities and integer approximations at source positions n+1 with absolute integer error<=1. The deterministic callback is required only on those positive source positions; arbitrary callback free variables are retained.
All natural numerator u>=0 and denominator v>0 satisfying the exact probability condition exp(1)*u/v<=1. No v>=3u or early-enclosure upper<=1 restriction.
The fixed canonical probability exp(1)/pi, arbitrary masks, ghost states, measurable Boolean credits including infinity, and arbitrary resource frames.
Every signed integer offset, positive natural divisor, and exact0<=pi-offset<=divisor probability domain. Negative offsets remain admissible.
Every natural numerator including zero, positive natural denominator, and exact numerator<=denominator*pi bound. Coarse interval endpoints may exceed1.
All natural a>=b>0, including a=b and nonreduced rational parameters; arbitrary masks, ghost states and ENNReal credits.
All natural x,z>=0 and y,t>0 with the sole exact probability restriction exp(-x/y)*z/t<=1. Compensated z>t and arbitrary x/y>1 are included.

Every summable nonnegative rational coefficient stream with positive term/error denominators, total sum<=1 and certified arbitrarily small nonnegative tail bounds. No monotonicity/rate, positive coefficients, strict mass bound or callback-FV restriction.
The fixed normalized probability3/4 times the ordinary convergent reciprocal-cube series zeta(3), arbitrary masks, ghost states, Boolean credits including infinity and resource frames.
